title: Studio 6 Fitness

services.name: S6 Pilates
services.desc: Our signature class provides a total body, high-octane, muscle quivering workout that melds cardio, strength training and Pilates. You will gain endurance, improve flexibility and strengthen and tone your body in ways traditional exercises cannot. High-energy music carries you through the heart-pumping workout with results you’ll see and feel. After just 6 sessions, you will discover how combining our 6 principles of Core, Strength, Balance, Flexibility, Endurance and Spirit will give you a whole body, core-centric experience that leaves you stronger and with more energy to live your happiest and healthiest life. Let’s grow stronger

services.name: S6 Private Lessons
services.desc: A great way to start your S6 journey is with a private session with an instructor where you will focus on your form and modifications and variations specific to your fitness goals and needs. Perfect for those with unique circumstances or hectic schedules. We can also do duets, trios, or a private group event. blurb: S6 Preston Hollow is conveniently located in the Northwest corner of Preston Road and Forest Lane. Within the Preston Forest Shopping Center, Studio 6 Fitness is located next door to Mathnasium and Capelli Salon. Studio 6 Fitness includes two restrooms, water bottle filling station, cubbies and an extensive selection of S6 Fitness and athleisure apparel.
